<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Caligni Skulker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2863)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Most often found on the surface are caligni skulkers, stealing staple goods and luxuries alike. When pressed into combat by more powerful caligni, skulkers will often be sacrificed in waves to wear down the enemy. Otherwise, skulkers are fairly cautious and prefer to flee unwinnable situations.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Caligni_Skulker.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Caligni Skulker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2863)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Caligni" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=745" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 48

**Perception** +8; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [light blindness](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=68)

**Languages**
[Caligni](/Languages.aspx?ID=28)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +4, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +10, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +8

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +0

**Dex** +4

**Con** +3

**Int** -1

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +1
</row>

**Items**
[darkening poison](/Weapons.aspx?ID=112) (3 doses), [Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 19 

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +6 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 30
(final night)

</row>

**Final Night** ([darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662)) When the caligni skulker dies, their remains dissolve into a 20-foot emanation of inky darkness before dissipating. The darkness extinguishes non-magical light sources and attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) magical [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640) as a 1st-rank effect with a +10 counteract modifier. The skulker's possessions are left in a pile where they died.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+4 piercing plus darkening poison

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4 piercing plus darkening poison

**Sneak Attack**   The caligni skulker deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) creatures.

**Tumble Behind**   When the caligni skulker [Tumbles Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=2370) a creature's space, that creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against the next attack the skulker makes against it before the end of its turn.

</column>
